How it works

From report to deploy in four steps

2 Triage

AI structures the feedback

AI asks one or two clarifying questions, then extracts: the scene (context), the blocker, and the real underlying need.

AI Triage FB-42

Context Sharing Q2 report with boss before a meeting

Blocker PDF export broken on Safari

Want Email reports directly to stakeholders

3 Connect & pick up

The Skill guides your agent through the fix

Install the Skill and connect MCP once (left). The Skill gives your agent the workflow; MCP and the CLI provide feedback data and status actions. Then run /makethisbetter pick to inspect the original evidence, claim the feedback, and start the fix (right). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex.

Why it matters

The gap AI coding can't close.

AI coding makes you ship fast — not perfect. The real gap isn't between code and deploy. It's between your users and your understanding of what they actually need. Here's how Make This Better closes it:

😰

The silent churn

Twenty-three users kept clicking Export, then left. Analytics and logs looked normal. The widget lets them report the problem on the spot, and your agent takes over.

⚡

The fast-shipper's blind spot

A user says "it doesn't work," and you have no idea why. The widget captures the URL, errors, and screenshot. Run /feedback pick, and your agent gets to work.

🧪

Testing without a QA team

Without a QA team, you click around before launch and hope for the best. Real users still hit problems you never imagined. The widget captures what happened, turning every session into a test.

💰

Needs that pay for themselves

Seven users ask for email sharing. AI turns their scattered feedback into one issue, and your agent builds it. A paid feature you nearly missed is now obvious.

Install the CLI, connect MCP, and start picking up feedback — all from your terminal.

为什么这很重要

人工智能编码的差距无法弥合。

人工智能编码可以让您快速发货——但并不完美。 真正的差距不在于代码和部署之间。 这是你的用户和你对他们实际需求的理解之间的关系。 以下是 Make This Better 关闭它的方法：

😰

无声的翻腾

23名用户不断点击“导出”，然后离开。 分析和日志看起来正常。 该小部件可让他们当场报告问题，然后由您的代理接手。

⚡

快件发货人的盲点

用户说“它不起作用”，而你不知道为什么。 该小部件捕获 URL、错误和屏幕截图。 运行 /feedback pick，您的代理即可开始工作。

🧪

没有 QA 团队的测试

如果没有 QA 团队，您只能在发布前到处点击并希望得到最好的结果。 真正的用户仍然会遇到你从未想象过的问题。 该小部件捕获发生的情况，将每个会话转变为测试。

💰

需要为自己付出代价

七个用户请求共享电子邮件。 人工智能将分散的反馈转化为一个问题，然后由您的代理来构建它。 您差点错过的付费功能现在变得显而易见。
